item.title: Cow gut enzyme could help target bacterial biofilms and antibiotic-resistant infections
item.description: The bacterium Acinetobacter baumannii poses a substantial threat in health care settings, readily forming biofilms on wounds and medical surfaces and contributing to persistent infections and delayed healing.
